column3: NASB follows the critical text with “the angels” (no “holy”); “throne of His glory” is “His glorious throne.”
NASB adds “something” and renders “took Me in” as “invited Me in.”
“Took You in” is rendered “invite You in.”
NASB renders “of these the least brothers” as “these brothers of Mine, even the least of them.”
“You who are cursed” is rendered “accursed ones.”
“Took Me in” is rendered “invite Me in.”
NASB has no “to Him,” like the critical text; “minister to” is rendered “take care of.”
